notes.title: Devlog Q1 25: Parkour, New fire systems, AO + Demo update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=qZnSAhrrMl0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Fire System [/h2]
[list]
[*] Oil: Now you can spill oil, leaving oil trails and puddles that can easily be ignited by any spark or fire source
[*] Gas. Now you can extinguish the streams of fire from the pipes. Also, the gas escaping from the pipes will ignite from any spark or fire source
[*] New item: Fire extinguisher. Allows extinguishing fire from pipes, oil puddles, and burning enemies. Causes a stun effect on organic enemies
[*] New item: Blowtorch. Allows igniting gas, oil, and organic enemies
[*] Reworked item: Oil Canister. Allows you to create oil trails and puddles, as well as pour oil on enemies to set them on fire
[*] Reworked items: Small and Large Oil Barrel. When damaged by a firearm, a leak with flammable oil occurs
[*] New explosive item: Heavy Propane Cylinder
[*] Skill improvement: Push skill now allows extinguishing fire, similar to the fire extinguisher
[*] Fire jets from pipes can now be blocked with any movable object
[*] Fixed visual artifacts related to flickering light from fire sources
[*] Added an "empty" state when focusing on an empty active object
[/list]

[h2]Player[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Parkour system.[/b] The player can pull themselves up and climb onto any objects in the level. A convenient system for climbing into ventilation shafts has also been added
[*] Added basic player specialization when choosing a suit in the intro. Options include soldier, scout, and engineer classes
[*] Reworked lean logic
[*] Adaptive weapons crosshair color. Red when focused on an enemy, green when focused on an interactive object
[*] New health and energy HUD
[*] Removed vertical camera shake while walking
[*] Added ability to catch rats and throw them at enemies or walls. Rats can also be pulled using telekinesis.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/3de99e5c5c42e5474ac26114b980fc68302cc66e.gif[/img]

[h2]Audio[/h2]
[b]Audio occlusion system.[/b] Sounds and enemy perception now depend on obstacles between them and the player. Sounds can also bend around obstacles, creating the effect of muffled, reflected sound.
[previewyoutube=LwzpqI5FUrA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Environment and Objects[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added severed body parts of station personnel. Can be used to throw at enemies or distract them
[*] Added corpses of station personnel with severed arms and legs
[*] New object: Cargo elevator for moving items between station decks.
[*] New object: Wall-mounted first aid cabinet
[*] New interactive floor hatches.
[*] Added technical tunnels in corridors under ceilings
[*] Intro: Reworked starting tutorial. 
[*] Intro: Added tutorial for dash and module usage.
[*] Intro: Added alternative ways to complete certain sections.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/3f44640f0d461d6664824c5f425c3770d4a3f398.jpg[/img]

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] New enemy: Explosive rat. Can be used as a weapon
[*] Enemies now react if a rat squeaks nearby
[*] Enemies no longer interrupt reloading while trying to dodge the player’s headshots
[*] Reworked AI for crawling enemies. Added fast in-place turning and increased jump distance
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/3fb3b7a35aa87a33c86cfc3f1d12bdc2a80b3228.gif[/img]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added sorting of player media in the order they were added to the database
[*] Now you can assign hotkeys to the psi-ability wheel, weapons, and consumables wheels
[*] Also you can rebind inventory menu keys
[*] Reworked quest markers
[*] Option to disable hints in the menu
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a critical bug that prevented the player from dying after switching ammo in Intro
[*] Fixed an issue with looped healing animation
[*] Fixed flashlight functionality when close to walls
[*] Fixed wrong hand pose after climbing a ladder
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies could lose sight of the player after a while
[*] Fixed rendering issues with helmet pieces while running
[*] Fixed shaking when moving in elevators
[*] Fixed the ability to interact with objects while under radiation damage
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog: Key features made in 2024 + Demo update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=C-cd50Uhl7Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Over the last few months, our efforts have been mainly focused on completing Chapter 1 and the Science Deck. We are happy to announce that they are now complete! Of course, there will still be some changes, fixes, and improvements. But it is already completely playable; the main storyline of the first chapter is ready! A full playthrough takes up to 12 hours.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/f88019d4e14676deab3f5f3e6384f011193a6b54.png[/img]

[h3]Below is a list of changes since the last devlog:[/h3]

[h2]Environment[/h2]
[list]
[*] Completion of the Science Deck
[*] Fancy neon signs above doors and areas
[*] Reworked distracting enemies tutorial at the beginning of the Science Deck
[*] New plants and decor
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/f5efcc00f776f4d28e73a193528f490308c86783.jpg[/img]

[h2]Player: Abilities and Modules[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved player lighting system. The illumination of your hands and weapons now represents how visible you are to enemies.
[*] New passive PSI ability: Weightlifter. All movable objects now have weight. Strength, abilities and modules affect the maximum weight a player can lift.
[*] Added passive skill tree: Combat
[*] New passive PSI ability: Life Recovery
[*] New passive PSI ability: Resuscitator
[*] New passive PSI ability: Sniper
[*] New passive PSI ability: Sharpshooter
[*] New passive PSI ability: Psionic Charger
[*] New passive PSI ability:  Bot Master. Allows you to disable security robots through security terminals
[*] New suit module: Jump Amplifier
[*] New suit software: Password Matcher
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/c003050d5930c9f6a3c71d2f437c8861fc2e00f9.gif[/img]

[h2]Weapons[/h2]
[list]
[*] New energy weapon: Energy Rifle
[*] New energy weapon: Hand Laser
[*] Revolver: Fixed front sight swinging when aiming
[*] Blaster: Fixed application of burning status effect
[*] Added sniper scope modification kit
[*] The selling price of a weapon now includes prices of all installed modules and bullets in the clip
[*] Energy weapon mode can now be changed from the menu
[*] Fixed the problem with the Tesla Gun arrow
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/49e813708d19a1e6e45a5ed31fff88f2baccee97.gif[/img]

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] New enemy: Psionic
[*] New enemy: Big Spider Robot
[*] Improved Security Robots sounds
[*] Enemies no longer endlessly pursue the player if they lose sight of him
[*] Enemies now react to objects thrown at them and go to check the place where the throw was made from
[*] Improved turrets intelligence. Now they better target the player on bridges. Also, turrets are now found on ceilings.
[*] Fixed Rats reaction to the noise
[/list]
[previewyoutube=Q_Zp34-e73U;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New items and objects[/h2]
[list]
[*] Automatic hacking tool. Allows you to automatically hack 1 device regardless of your skills
[*] Throwable glass. Breaks making a lot of noise
[*] Tray. Collectable item for sale
[*] Movable barrels with radioactive gas that can be penetrated by shots
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/fc7660ce891fcefa66dd8dfe9289662aaa8bb9e6.gif[/img]

[h2]Fixes and improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed stutters when entering some zones
[*] Fixed the problem with the cursor disappearing in a menu
[*] Fixed display of keys in hints if they were changed by the player
[*] The player no longer resurrects with a movable item in his hands
[*] Cameras no longer look through walls
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented you from running if you died with zero stamina
[*] Psi abilities no longer automatically bind to free hotkeys after resurrection
[*] Fixed a number of errors when upgrading a character with equipped stat enhancement modules
[*] Fixed bug with saving state of hacked vending machines
[*] Fixed a looped healing animation if you die with a syringe in your hands
[*] Now you can enter a password without activating a device
[*] And many other small (and not so small) issues
[/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
We will focus on polishing Chapter 1 and improving the Intro. For example, we want to finally implement climbing. Also, we plan to re-voice the demo with professional actors. 
We will continue to work on new enemies, weapons, abilities and modules.
Once Chapter 1 and the intro are polished enough, we'll move on to Chapters 2 and 3.

P.S.: if you want to participate in the beta testing of Chapter 1 (a little bit later and for free, of course), the announcement will be in our Discord channel (link below). 

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Lonely Space Demo Update 0.3.04 + Dev Log
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=J902BImV52I;full][/previewyoutube]

We've been hard at work on the player's active and passive abilities system. Most of them will be available to try out in the demo. There is a list of the main changes and improvements:

[h2]PSI Abilities and Passives[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added passive skill trees: Survival and Technician
[*] Survival passive skill trees: Stuning Strike, Improved Treatment, Energy Efficiency
[*] Technician passive skill trees: Hacker, Repairman
[*] Passive skills for active abilities that add new possibilities
[*] New PSI Ability: Telekinesis
[*] New PSI Ability: Psionic Barrier
[*] New PSI Ability: True Vision
[*] New PSI Ability: Bending of Light
[*] New PSI Ability: Fire Trap
[*] New PSI Ability: Lightning Strike
[*] New PSI Ability: Corrosive Blast
[*] New PSI Ability: Crimson Clot
[*] Berser PSI Ability was reworked
[*] Now, to hack complex digital locks or vending machines, you need to unlock a specific passive ability in the Hacker tree.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/6562521b589cc6140e2beadb0bec15601ac387e3.gif[/img]

[h2]New weapons[/h2]
[list]
[*] EMP Grenade
[*] Corrosive Grenade
[*] Nuke Grenade
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/d91dd19f559c26db71bf826e1d12b48abeb60d2d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/f206539bc12b13dae3d403a9382845bb8dd5c6c1.gif[/img]

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] New enemy: an armored security officer with a helmet and a shotgun.
[*] Mechanical enemies can now be temporarily disabled when taking electrical damage.
[*] After using the Bending of Light ability, enemies lose visibility of the player.
[*] Improved animation of getting up from the floor after falling from the Push ability.
[*] Cameras no longer see the player in dark places or when he uses Bending of Light ability.
[*] Uncollected enemy weapons are no longer saved and disappear after reloading.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/2011503cfad5456e71d732b179369c80b2dc51b5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Fixes and improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] New tutorial on upgrading player's character
[*] Enemy bodies now fly apart from grenade explosions
[*] When turning with an item in your hands, the item now always moves with the camera.
[*] Fixed issue with equipping weapons when picking up an item.
[*] Fixed a bug with double credits withdrawal for death.
[*] The circular panel has been improved to provide access to more abilities and items.
[*] Fixed a bug with installing software into the suit.
[*] Added status for dash recharge.
[*] The broken status for weapons dropped from enemies' hands.
[*] Broken weapons are no longer automatically bound to hotkeys.
[*] Reworked hacking buttons for all devices.
[*] Now when selling items the current selling price is visible on the screen
[/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

We're working on environment and plot of the Science Bay beyond the demo. There you will find new challenges, enemies and weapons. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/af3d8670bb439d3139e29aca9ddb6cdc46993da9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Lonely Space Demo Update 0.2.08 + Dev Log
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=eDEjdiZBa-o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Enemies and AI[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New enemy: Infected station staff with a pistol[/b]
[*] Infected staff foes now can dodge melee attacks
[*] Infected staff foes now can evade headshot when they see the player aiming for their head
[*] You can break enemy weapons by shooting it
[*] Enemies with melee weapons no longer stand near the tunnels where the player is hiding, allowing themselves to be beaten
[*] [b]New enemy: Mutaed lab rat[/b]
[*] One rat never attacks, it seeks help and run away from the player
[*] Rats swarm logic, they attacks the player as a group
[*] Improved hearing of enemies up close, reduced when away from the noise source
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/b57951acec83d05dc3434862bbb668c0ec514a26.gif[/img]

[h2]Suit management[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New item: Data disk with software for the suit[/b]
[*] Foe life analyzer soft rework: you need to analyze each new enemy to reveal its life indicator
[*] New soft: player visibility and noise analyzer. Shows how visible the player is to enemies at any moment and indicates the level of produced noise
[*] New soft: Foe resistances analyzer. Analyzes enemies' resistance to each type of damage
[*] Now you can improve the player's inventory size from 70 to 112 cells
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/63ef8ecf4702e271eb61a945927757e4bdcb55d7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Environment[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added light switches for most rooms
[*] Replaced door unlock buttons
[*] Switches and door buttons can be pressed using shots and throwing objects
[*] Broken wiring causing electrical damage
[*] Added plant pots in recreation areas
[*] Added an elevator at the end of the demo
[*] Added a security room at the end of the demo, which can be reached in 3+ different ways
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/a96a62decc3fd23be9f00aa25a8656ed5b8f1530.jpg[/img]

[h2]Fixes and improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed completion of quests if completed in reverse order
[*] Fixed camera issues when switching from melee to guns
[*] Fixed a bug with inventory freezing
[*] Player damage indicators now rotate when the camera is rotated
[*] Fixed errors in player visibility calculations
[*] Some visual fixes
[/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

We are finishing development of female stuff and enemies, they will be available in the next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/986090b557e5ccab2d96c3d38d76baa0d0360dc7.png[/img]

A system of modules and suit modifications is also currently in development.
We are also working on further development of the Science Bay, its quests and environment.

Stay tuned for updates!
Lonely Space team

notes.title: Lonely Space Demo 0.2 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Light and Stealth systems changes[/h1]
First of all, almost any light source can now be destroyed. And now light affects the player's visibility to enemies. Thus, the player can change the environment and gameplay to suit his playing style.
Next, UV lamps and hidden inscriptions and signs on the walls were added, which are visible only in the dark under the light of a UV lamp. Hand lamps and tripod lanterns can now be moved!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/86917bc15e079ebc5f747df8e0b04ddeac5bbfec.gif[/img]

The following parameters affect the player's visibility to enemies:
[list]
[*] Whether the room light is on or off.
[*] Whether is a working light source near the player or not. Each light source has a power that affects the player's visibility.
[*] Whether the player's flashlight is turned on or not. Turning on a flashlight in the dark greatly increases the player's visibility!
[*] Whether the player is standing or crouched.
[*] Enemy's sight power
[/list]
An issue where enemies would notice the player at close range from behind has also been fixed. You can now use a flashlight to lure enemies to eliminate them one by one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/316d04c4694930c411e184b066ed6b38ac200631.gif[/img]

The entire station has been divided into small zones, which [b]significantly increased performance[/b], because now only the zone in which the player is and those neighboring it are active. We also reduce the spread of noise in neighboring zones.

[h2]Gameplay changes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] We decided to hide enemies' healthbars by default. It was breaking immersion, hiding added more tension to the game and increased the horror component. But you can still enable it through the options.
[*] The "Broken" status has been added to weapon screens, which are impossible to miss.
[*] Shotgun spreading was reduced. But it's no longer affected by Perception stat.
[*] We have changed auto assign order for stimpacks to prevent wrong usage.
[*] If a weapon is broken, the repair kit only repairs it 10%, rather than the usual 25%. This is necessary to make the sale and repair of broken weapons unprofitable.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/d9b273b32ed273c4b0e004a293ab7445d5a64127.png[/img]

[h2]Levels changes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] A new supply room in the second lab.
[*] We've changed the colors of some rooms to make the station more livable.
[*] Some plants were added to green rest room.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/65ad46fb35f29885c343ef5763d3844c09e7676b.gif[/img]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

We will continue to improve the demo version and release updates in parallel with the development of the main game.
We are currently working on a model of overalls for a Cassiopeia station employee. On its basis, dead members of the station and various enemies will be created. Some of them will be armed with firearms, some will use PSI abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720664/08ba04ee6912e51cb333926391bf0f570365cecd.png[/img]

Nearest plans:
[list]
[*] Development and addition of new enemies and improvement of their AI
[*] Re-voicing of audiologists and incoming messages
[*] Reworked intro, improved training on basic mechanics
[*] New PSI abilities
[*] New melee weapons, firearms, grenades and mines
[*] And much more!
[/list]

Thank you for being with us. Together we will make a great game!
Lonely Space team!
